title: Peruvian Ceviche
description: White fish cured in lime juice for minutes, not hours, with chilli, red onion, and the cloudy leftover marinade poured back over. Nothing is cooked with heat.
notes: Buy the fish the same day and keep everything cold. This is the one recipe where ingredient quality is the entire technique.

ingredients.name: sea bass
ingredients.note: skinless, boneless, cut into 2cm cubes; any firm white fish works

ingredients.name: aji amarillo
ingredients.note: seeded and sliced; substitute a mild yellow chilli

steps.text: Soak the sliced red onion in ice water to take the harsh edge off, then drain it well.
Whisk the lime juice with the grated garlic, ginger, and salt to make the leche de tigre.
Toss the sea bass with the salt and let it sit briefly before the acid goes anywhere near it.
steps.tip: Salting first firms the surface so the fish cures evenly instead of going chalky outside and raw inside.

steps.text: Pour the leche de tigre over the fish and stir once.
steps.tip: Three minutes. The cubes should turn opaque at the edge and stay translucent at the centre.

steps.text: Fold through the drained onion, aji amarillo, and cilantro, and serve immediately with sliced sweet potato.
